title: Customs Duty Estimator
description: Estimate landed cost: item value times your duty rate plus shipping and fees.
howto: Enter the duty rate % that applies.
Add shipping, insurance, and any other fees.
Read the duty owed, total landed cost, and effective rate.

faqs.q: Where do I find the real duty rate?
faqs.a: From your country's customs tariff schedule, usually by HS product code. This tool cannot know your product's classification.

faqs.q: Is duty charged on shipping too?
faqs.a: It depends on the country. Many charge duty on the CIF value (goods + insurance + freight). Enter the value basis your customs uses.

faqs.q: Why is this only an estimate?
faqs.a: Rates vary by country, product, trade agreements, and de minimis thresholds. Always confirm with your customs authority or broker.
